The part of a tree that grows underground is the root.

Regarding the narrative style in the provided text, the author employs an alternating first-person point of view, shifting between different members of a space expedition team. The tone is dynamic, moving from the optimistic and curious perspective of a scientist to the pragmatic and cautious outlook of an engineer. The language reflects this duality by being technical when describing machinery and phenomena, yet becoming more reflective and philosophical when the characters consider their existence in the universe.
